title: Understanding the Models
text: The first equation represents the un-regularized linear regression model using the original design matrix. The second equation uses the mean-centered design matrix. Consider how centering affects the intercept term.

title: Effect of Lambda on Predictions
text: As lambda approaches $$\infty$$, the regularization term dominates the cost function. Think about what happens to the coefficients in this scenario.

title: Choosing the Correct Prediction
text: What happens to the coefficients when the regularization term becomes very large?
choices: the mean of the true $$y$$ values
